name: plan-reset-guards
description: Every destructive plan/furniture action is guarded and honestly labelled: the File menu's plan-level vs furniture-level entries, the New-apartment chooser (empty canvas / starter room), and confirms on Reset apartment, template apply, saved-plan load and saved-plan delete.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-honest-labels
steps.eval: (function(){var rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel .menu-item')).map(function(e){return e.textContent||''});var need=['New apartment…','Reset apartment…','Restore demo furniture…','Clear furniture…'];var missing=need.filter(function(n){return !rows.some(function(r){return r.indexOf(n)>=0})});if(missing.length)throw new Error('missing: '+missing.join(', ')+' | got: '+rows.join(' / '));var stale=rows.filter(function(r){return /Reset to the floor-plan default/.test(r)});if(stale.length)throw new Error('stale label still present');return 'ok'})()

steps.name: assert-nothing-destroyed-yet
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();if(s.floorPlan.rooms.length===0)throw new Error('plan already cleared before choosing');return 'rooms='+s.floorPlan.rooms.length+' items='+s.items.length})()

steps.name: assert-confirm-open
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();if(!s.confirmRequest)throw new Error('Reset apartment did not confirm');return s.confirmRequest.title+' | '+s.confirmRequest.message})()

steps.name: assert-plan-buttons-guarded
steps.eval: (function(){var b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(function(e){return (e.textContent||'').trim()});if(b.indexOf('New…')<0)throw new Error('no New… button; got '+b.slice(0,40).join('|'));if(b.indexOf('Reset to HDB…')<0)throw new Error('no Reset to HDB… button');return 'ok'})()

steps.name: assert-plan-confirm
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();if(!s.confirmRequest)throw new Error('Reset to HDB did not confirm');return s.confirmRequest.title})()

steps.name: assert-truly-empty
steps.eval: (function(){var p=window.__store.getState().floorPlan;if(p.walls.length||p.rooms.length)throw new Error('not empty: walls='+p.walls.length+' rooms='+p.rooms.length);if(window.__store.getState().items.length)throw new Error('furniture survived a new plan');return 'empty ok'})()

steps.name: assert-single-undo-restores-both
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();if(s.floorPlan.rooms.length===0)throw new Error('undo did not restore the plan');if(s.items.length===0)throw new Error('undo did not restore the furniture');return 'rooms='+s.floorPlan.rooms.length+' items='+s.items.length})()
